component.name: Binark
component.summary: Convert text, numbers and files between numeral systems

description.p: Binark is a native GNOME application for converting text, integers and files to their representation in a chosen numeral system and back.

ul.li: UTF-8 text to and from bases 2–12, 16, 32 and 64
Streaming file encoding and decoding in the selected base
Configurable formatting, optional local history and light/dark themes

description.p: Text and files can now be encoded in any supported base.

ul.li: Bases 2–12, 16, 32 and 64 for text and files
Streaming file conversion with the selected base
